definitions: All values are observed execution timings, not controlled standalone speed benchmarks or FLOPs.
Selected update costs stop at the chosen checkpoint. Searches, other LR candidates and later unused steps are excluded from selected-recipe costs but included in stage wall time.
GPU stage wall time includes loading, compilation, training, evaluation and failures; CPU orchestration wrappers are excluded to avoid double counting nested stages.
GPU stage wall time uses deduplicated receipts for this study only.
These are observed timings; consult resource_budget_audit.json for this study. Uninterrupted system-level GPU exclusivity is not guaranteed.
Offline setup includes saved gradient collection and predictor fitting with its validation and static audit overhead; oracle-state drift audits are separately reported.
Shared cache acquisition is charged once to each hypothetical standalone predictor setup; do not sum selected-recipe costs to estimate total research cost.
Warmup is shared and reported separately. Online audits are excluded from synchronized update time. Offline and online costs do not include hyperparameter search.
Selected-recipe totals omit model loading, dataset initialization and unmeasured checkpoint I/O; they are scoped training costs, not complete end-to-end deployment latency.
Adaptive obtains20 true-gradient example exposures per update (4 current-batch plus16 validation); fewer gradient examples do not imply lower wall time.

CV4 and Oracle4 each obtain4 current-batch true-gradient example exposures per update. CV4 additionally runs prefix inference and the frozen predictor for32 examples. Independent stopping points may have different total labels; the separately saved same-setting control matches both per-step and total online labels.

Mean controls use20 true-gradient examples per update at oracle or selected-predictor settings; only the adaptive predictor has the same online gradient-exposure budget at matched stopping. Controls are seed101diagnostics.
Time ratios compare independently selected stopping points. Interpret only alongside heldout accuracy; they do not by themselves establish matched-quality acceleration.
